title: Lightroom's Vectorscope Turns Color Grading From Guesswork Into Measurement
excerpt: The vectorscope has finally arrived in Lightroom, and it does for color what the histogram did for exposure: it shows you what is actually there, so you stop grading by feel on a screen you cannot trust.

title: One Strobe, One White Wall, Two Portraits That Look Nothing Alike
excerpt: A single snooted strobe and a plain white wall can make two portraits that look like they came from different studios. The difference is not the gear. It is distance, angle, and treating shadows as part of the picture.

title: A $149 Wide-Angle Prime That Makes the Expensive Ones Hard to Justify
excerpt: The Sirui Swift 20mm f/2.4 is a full-frame ultra-wide with an aperture ring, a function button, weather sealing, and a 4.5-star review, for $149. The wide-angle lens was the last place beginners were expected to pay up. That expectation just broke.
